source_standards: Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules (TNCDBR) 2019
Mumbai DCPR 2034 (Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai)
Unified Building Bye-Laws Delhi (UBBL 2016) / Master Plan Delhi 2021
notes: v1 (2026-04-27): Initial 6-city coverage. Simplified to base FAR + max ground-coverage per city.
Real DCRs are tiered by plot-area + road-width — these are flat estimates for v0.1 advisory feasibility.
Mumbai/Bangalore add road-width-tiered FSI premium not modelled in v0.1 — output disclosed as 'base estimate'.
Delhi small-plot uniform 350% FAR allowed for plots ≤ 100 sqm — modelled separately.
Stilt parking and basement are excluded from FAR for all 6 cities (national convention).

chennai.regulation: TNCDBR 2019 (Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules)
notes: FAR raised from 1.5 to 2.0 in 2019 amendment (G.O. effective Oct 2018).
Premium FSI possible up to 3.25 with payment to CMDA — not modelled in v0.1.
Excludes ecologically-sensitive zones (Aquifer Recharge, Red Hills, CRZ).
Stilt parking, basement, balcony (≤5%) excluded from FAR.

bangalore.authority: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagar Palike (BBMP) / Bangalore Development Authority (BDA)
notes: Plotted developments allowed 55% ground coverage per BMR rules.
Real FAR is 1.75-3.25 driven by road width — v0.1 uses 2.0 mid-band estimate.
Premium FSI on roads >12m wide. Not modelled.
Stilt + basement excluded from FAR (BBMP convention).
FAR varies 1.5-2.5 based on plot tier — v0.1 uses 1.75 mid-band.
60% ground coverage typical for residential plots up to 500 sqm.
Stilt + basement excluded from FAR.
Island City base FSI 1.33; suburbs 1.00. v0.1 uses 1.33 (the more permissive of the two).
Real FSI tiers up sharply with road width: 9-12m road = 2.0; 12-18m road = 2.4; 18-27m = 2.7+.
Plus 35% fungible compensatory area on top of basic FSI (premium).
v0.1 conservative — actual permissible FAR usually higher with road-width premiums.
Output discloses: 'base FAR — actual may be higher with premium charges'.
Base FSI 1.10, can be augmented with TDR + premium up to 3.0 in some zones.
60% ground coverage typical for residential.
v0.1 uses base only — no premium TDR modelling.
Plots ≤ 100 sqm: uniform FAR 350% (3.5) and 75% ground coverage (small-plot relaxation per MPD-2021 amendment).
Plots > 100 sqm: FAR scales 1.5-3.0 by plot tier; v0.1 uses 1.5 base.
Stilt mandatory for plots 100-1000 sqm (notification, NOT in UBBL itself — known gotcha).
Basement, mumty, lift shaft excluded from FAR.
